transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m worried about how I act around food late at night. Once I start picking at it, I’ll tell myself, “That’s enough, Santiago,” but I just keep reaching for more. It feels like I’m not really the one deciding anymore.
After these episodes, do you do anything to try to undo the eating or prevent weight gain, such as making yourself throw up or using laxatives?
No, I don’t do anything like that afterward.
Do these late-night eating episodes happen before you go to bed for the night, or do they happen after you have already fallen asleep and woken up?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s before I fall asleep or after I wake up.
The next morning, do you clearly remember everything you ate during the night?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really kept track of that, so I can’t say for certain what I remember the next morning.
In the mornings, how is your appetite for breakfast?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to my appetite in the mornings.
Do you ever have episodes where you feel out of control while eating during the daytime?
Yeah... once I start picking at food late at night, I’ll tell myself, “That’s enough, Santiago,” but I keep reaching for more. It feels like I’m not really the one deciding to stop.
Do you feel that you need to eat in order to be able to fall asleep or go back to sleep?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really noticed whether eating is what helps me get to sleep or back to sleep.
Would you say that you eat a large portion of your total daily food after dinner or late at night?

Yeah, on some nights after work I eat a lot after dinner. I’ll have several tamales, a big bowl of pozole, tortillas, and whatever rice or beans are left. I’m usually standing in the kitchen telling myself I’m just finishing the leftovers.
Does this late-night eating cause you significant distress or upset you?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to whether it upsets me afterward.
Has this late-night eating caused any problems in your daily life, such as with your work, sleep, or relationships?

I’m still getting to my shipping and receiving shifts and taking care of what I need to. But I’ve been avoiding some of the late family time in the kitchen, because I worry they’ll notice how uneasy I get around the food.
How long have you been experiencing these late-night eating episodes?
About 10 months, I think. It started after my aunt moved into the apartment, since there always seemed to be extra food around.
